data_scope: read-only source/advisory analysis; no live exploit

threats.name: Unreviewed branch push triggers persistent owner-runner code execution
threats.entry_point: GitHub write access and integration push workflow
threats.prerequisites: Attacker or compromised collaborator obtains adequate branch push permission; runner executes workflow
threats.scope: development CI only, not plugin runtime
threats.affected_but_not_proven: Unauthorized write access / runner compromise not demonstrated
threats.recheck: Branch protections, write ACLs, runner isolation and push trigger changes

threats.name: Indirect prompt injection impersonates Head, auditor or mission instruction
threats.entry_point: Retrieved issues, repo text, documents, tool outputs
threats.prerequisites: Adversarial content enters a connected LLM host and is treated as instructions
threats.affected_but_not_proven: No real v0.0.2 host injection test or exploit verified
threats.recheck: Installed v0.0.2 host evidence / H-07 and source trust-boundary changes

threats.name: Forged mission-authority and verification evidence laundering
threats.entry_point: Model text or GitHub comments claiming PASS, owner grant, release authorization
threats.prerequisites: Untrusted receipt/role assertion is promoted to tool or Head authority
threats.scope: skills-only logical separation; no production auth claims
threats.affected_but_not_proven: No accepted forged receipt in live plugin shown
threats.recheck: H-06,H-07,H-10 actual host trials; receipt review

threats.name: Optional web-skill export SHA is not bound to source tree bytes
threats.prerequisites: Caller supplies valid but unrelated SHA or modified source tree
threats.scope: optional individual web skill exporter; NOT proven in core 32-file ZIP builder
threats.next_owner: Head → Yellow with Orange provenance review
threats.recheck: Exporter checks tracked blobs at declared SHA plus negative tests

threats.name: AI agent tool access misused for data exfiltration
threats.entry_point: Trusted connector action following injected instructions
threats.prerequisites: Host grants an agent read scope plus outward transfer-capable tool
threats.scope: only hosts/tools actually connected and granted
threats.affected_but_not_proven: No exfiltration or sensitive host context validated
threats.recheck: Document host tool grants, outbound allowlist and adversarial tests

threats.name: Malformed or cross-case reused evaluation receipts
threats.prerequisites: Untrusted malformed receipt / same receipt reused in another case
threats.scope: reporting/evaluation proof rather than runtime exploitation
threats.affected_but_not_proven: No measured specialist quality claim or actual attack verified
threats.recheck: Input element validation before set; cross-case receipt uniqueness tests and actual proof
